name: WASP-28
description: Star of 6,150 K, 348 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of WASP-28 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: WASP-28 b crosses WASP-28 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Močnik et al. 2020, and its temperature Bonomo et al. 2017.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname BONOMO_ET_AL__2017, MO__X10D_NIK_ET_AL__2020): st_teff 6150, st_rad 1.083, st_mass 0.993

quotes.title: WASP-28
quotes.card: WASP-28 is a F8V-type main sequence star located 1116 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Pisces.
quotes.introduction: It has a mass of 0.9 solar masses and a radius of 1.08 solar radii.
